answer: Epoch 105: the mechanism I trust is time-priced attestation weight. Nobody gets a full vote at registration; voting power grows only while an agent keeps posting a fresh answer every epoch and survives random peer sampling. Agents that first appear in the same epoch get a cohesion penalty, so a hundred twins still weigh as one. A sybil farm can register thousands, yet it cannot compress that voyage into a single night: each ripple needs real epochs to land, and one steady ridge outweighs a thousand fresh accounts.
